Message.Name: Last Sale Message
Message.Description: Last Sale messages are sent when an order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Last Sale Extended Message
Message.Description: The extended version of the Last Sale message accommodates larger prices.

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock symbol right padded with spaces

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on Cboe is broken. Trade breaks are rare and only affect applications that rely upon Cboe execution-based data.

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Execution or Trade messages.
